title: Warung Beverage Outpost | Walt Disney World Resort
body_text: Warung Outpost Located in Asia at Disney's Animal Kingdom Theme Park Set out on an icy trip, where the signature Rafiki Wildberry and DOLE Whip® Orange Float is offered—featuring DOLE Whip Orange and Fanta® Orange, swirled by Wildberry syrup into a tasty blend and topped with a white chocolate character medallion!View Menu American Mexican Bars & Lounges Dining Plan Meals Not Accepted Operating Hours – 11:00 AM to 5:00 PM Valid admission required.
